protocol.analysis_verdict: the analysis code carries two edits. Every module reads its capture-step list from commitment/grid.py instead of a hard-coded tuple, so the same cells can be re-derived on the ten-step and the seven-step grids. And pool_targets.py drops out-of-grid steps from the per-target analyses it loads, which the parent never needed because its per-target files only ever held its own seven steps. No estimator, probe, metric or bootstrap was touched.

iptm_vs_interface.caveat: ipTM and interface PAE are read off the same AlphaFold forward pass; their reading errors are correlated, so agreement here is weaker evidence than an independent re-fold would be

frac_tm_variance_inside_modal_label.note: superseded by rounded_away; kept because it is what the earlier modal-cluster version reported

modal_reference_stability.note: the modal-representative sensitivity curve is only interpretable for targets whose reference cluster is the same at every capture step

rounded_away.note: share of total pairwise structural distance that lies between designs sharing a cluster label, which the 0/1 ruler sets to zero; computed over every label, not inside the modal cluster only

schedule.assumed_mode_loading_status: ASSUMPTION, not a measurement. Used only for the time_native_assumed sensitivity, never for the headline.

bootstrap_replay_matches_spread.note: The CV ratio and the paired across-axis gap change are read off a replay of spread()'s own bootstrap. Before anything is read off it, the replay's four corrected-CV intervals and six pairwise-difference intervals are required to match spread()'s reported ones on every axis and both units.

linear_rescaling_is_a_no_op.note: t = step/nsteps is a linear rescaling, so it cannot move a CV. This is the control for the whole analysis: anything the curved schedules do move is attributable to their curvature, not to remapping as such.

verdict.text: The gap clears zero on both of Complexa's clocks at the lead unit. The schedule objection is closed: the interface-versus-fold spread difference is not an artifact of measuring two differently curved time axes in shared step units.
